audit_word_budget_note: The applicable source limit spans all prior unique derived prose and audit/recheck notes. Keep notes concise, avoid quotes, and use procedural support judgments when no new factual paraphrase is needed. Count every new substantive explanation.

budgets.counting_basis: Final whitespace count of every distinct authored card, first-body checkpoint, takeaway, substantive evidence/relationship note, source-specific qualification, selection-review source-derived sentence, and retained exact excerpt. Identical copies across artifacts counted once per page. Bodies and takeaways with multiple cited evidence pages are conservatively charged to each page. Frozen imports, bibliographic locators/titles, acquisition failures, and procedural author-review/research-note metadata excluded. Full text and origins are retained in source-prose-ledger.json. Cross-shard shared-source reconciliation remains a coordinator responsibility.
